scope: regional style and tile-loading sample before full atlas
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
EDIT TARGET: Image 1, the exact 1536x1024 geographically registered atlas guide. Image 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, a detail crop of the user's older richly painted atlas. Image 3 is the exact binary land mask: white=land, black=water.
Repaint Image 1 into the beautiful detailed illustrative style of Image 2. Retain the EXACT framing, aspect 3:2, exact normalized pixel coastline locations and water silhouettes of image 1 and image 3. Do NOT move or enlarge any lake or sea. Do not add any island to the Caspian Sea. Its entire large blue interior is continuous water. Its north end must stay at about x640,y320 and south end at x670,y635 in the 1536x1024 guide. The Black Sea stays around x120..440,y390..510; Persian Gulf x590..760,y820..970. These coordinates are positioning instructions, never visible text.
This is a top-down painted regional map, from Egypt/Greece on the LEFT to Himalayas on the RIGHT, not the Italy geography of the style crop.
Paint rich cobalt/turquoise seas, golden shores, individual tiny tree clusters where the guide shows green, warm grassland, tan dunes and rocky deserts in Sahara/Egypt, Arabia, Iran and Central Asia. Dry Tibetan plateau stays dry ochre. No forest or green lawn on deserts. Flowing rivers only in real corridors.
Turn brown mountain guidance bands into organic connected mountain chains, with charming dimensional ochre/gray watercolor crags as in image 2. Three visual altitude types: low ridges up to 3000m are smaller and snow-free; 3000–6000m ranges have partial snowy summits; 6000–9000m Himalayan and Pamir massifs are large, majestic and snowy. Ural mountains (the narrow vertical brown strip in upper middle) and Carpathians (far upper-left) are LOWER than 3000m: absolutely no snowy summits there. Caucasus has partial snow; Pamir/Hindu Kush and Himalaya at lower-right have high snowy massifs, dry highlands behind, greener Indian lowland below.
Keep all continents, coastlines and physical feature placement locked to Image 1. Paint inside the same geographic regions, do not redesign them for composition. Maintain detailed brushwork and crisp small painted leaves/crags. A coherent continuous hand-painted image, not repeating texture stamps.
No names, text, flags, boats, country boundary lines, grid, legend, margin, frame, blank areas, blur or atmospheric haze. Native high-resolution detail, ideally 3072x2048 if supported.
